page.overview:
Who is Richard B. Barnett?

Admiral Richard B. Barnett was a Starfleet officer during the Dominion War.

In 2374, the starship reported Barnett as missing in action. His name was listed in a casualty list that was displayed in the wardroom of Deep Space 9. (, okudagram)
